maddeler.e:
نلتهم (form VIII)
# نَلْتَهِمُ (naltahimu) /nal.ta.hi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# نُلْتَهَمُ (nultahamu) /nul.ta.ha.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# نَلْتَهِمَ (naltahima) /nal.ta.hi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# نُلْتَهَمَ (nultahama) /nul.ta.ha.ma/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
